NEW: We are taking Mamdani’s rent freeze to court.

Gandolfo DiFiore, a longtime New York real-estate developer and owner-operator of multifamily and rent-stabilized properties, recently intervened through his company, DiFiore Realty LLC, in the lawsuit challenging Mamdani’s rent freeze, joining the plaintiffs represented by former Deputy Mayor Randy Mastro.

The Manhattan Institute is providing financial support for the intervention, and we recently filed an amicus curiae brief in the case.

@J

In 2020, William Tolliver got into a gunfight with two other men. A 9-year-old child who was walking to the science center with his family was shot. A 50-year-old woman was killed. 6 others were injured.

Tolliver and his friend, who also took part in the shooting, had 65 prior arrests.

Tolliver received only 48 months in prison—and was allowed to serve some of that time at his grandmother's house.

He was released this week.
